quarterly_data.signal: Q2 and H1 2026 detail from the results deck (beyond the call): Q2 operating profit NT$3,761 million (+55.1% YoY), operating margin 7.8% vs 6.3%; net income attributable to owners of the parent NT$2,392 million (+295.3%), Q2 EPS NT$2.19 vs NT$0.63; Q2 R&D expenses NT$4,218 million (+61.6%). Capital expenditures: Q2 NT$17,009 million vs NT$8,751 million (+94.4%), H1 NT$29,688 million vs NT$14,388 million (+106.3%). Inventories NT$28,590 million at June 30, 2026 (+76.7% YoY).

quarterly_data.signal: Optical boards and capacity (results deck): for optical modules, 1.6T and subsequent generations require mSAP technology; the company says demand for high-end optical-module PCBs continues to outstrip supply globally and it is expanding related capacity. Thailand: Fab 1 (high-end HDI, HLC and optical-module products, mass production since 3Q25); three additional fabs and one mechanical drilling center are under construction, with trial production expected to start progressively from 4Q26. Shenzhen Campus III smart manufacturing base (broke ground July 2026) will comprise three plants focused on high-end substrate-like PCBs for AI servers and optical modules, plus advanced FPCs for AI devices. New capacity comes online in phases from 2026 to 2030 in line with customer qualification and mass-production schedules.
